# jank mini 2.2: cost estimate, both orders (generated by cost.py; parts snapshot 2026-11-16, newer parts read later: their 'read' field)

72.1 x 72.1 mm, 2 layers (1.6 mm), top side only, **JLC Standard** (every ESP32-S3 module at JLC is Standard only). **Anchor: JLCONE, 2026-11-15 17:58: the dummy board (placed, no tracks), 10 pcs, battery order, top side, Standard; 57 part types: PCB 6.40, setup 25.75, stencil 8.27, parts 94.56, feeders loading 88.35, SMT 9.36, packaging 0.51; shipping and the hand-soldered parts not included: USD 233.20.** The table below re-prices today's BOM with that quote's fees; re-quote before ordering. One board, two orders: **usb** (USB power only) and **battery** (the cell circuit too; both orders the TPS63802 buck-boost and the TPS61023 5 V aux boost). Shipping: not included; JLC's checkout shows it. Taxes and the case are not included either. Every fee is an estimate (sources below).

### 10 boards: 5 full + 5 MIDI-only (USD; the DINs and the screen left out of both)

| | JLC | bought with the order (the user solders) | total | a board |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **one battery order of 10**, 5 of them finished by hand as MIDI-only (no cells, no toggle: R62's pads bridged, no CV jacks; their charger, cell parts and CLK / RST drivers fitted but unused) | 207.71 | 8.38 | **216.09** | 21.61 |
| **two orders**: usb x 5 (MIDI-only) + battery x 5 (full) | 308.96 | 8.38 | **317.34** | 31.73 |

One order saves 101.25 USD (one set of setup / stencil / feeder fees instead of two). The MIDI-only boards from the battery order run from USB through the power path and the TPS63802 (no cell needed); R62 is a DNP 0402 land in that order: a blob or a 0 ohm 0402 bridges it. Shipping: one parcel either way (not included; JLC's checkout shows it).
